title: Mirabel and the Autopsy
author: Jude Underhill
blurb: Xanthe Vasquez, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
